test_command: dotnet build api/Biolog.Api/Biolog.Api.csproj && dotnet test tests/features/bio-int-005/Biolog.Features.ImportConflictReview.Tests.csproj && dotnet test tests/dotnet/Biolog.IntegrationTests/Biolog.IntegrationTests.csproj && bash scripts/check-module-project-references.sh && python3 scripts/check-contract-freeze.py && python3 scripts/check-traceability.py --all && bash scripts/secret-scan.sh && (cd web && npx tsc --noEmit && npx next build) && (cd tests/frontend && npx vitest run unit) && (cd tests/frontend && npx playwright test bio-int-005-conflict-review.spec.ts bio-ux-002-shell.spec.ts bio-ux-013-axe-baseline.spec.ts bio-int-004-webhooks.spec.ts)
notes:
New feature project api/features/bio-int-005 (Biolog.Features.ImportConflictReview). AC01: Domain/IImportConflictGateway.cs is a read-only seam onto BIO-INT-002's own already-computed FieldConflict comparison (ImportBatchService.ListBatchesAsync), wrapped by an adapter in BioInt005Module.cs - no ProjectReference, mirrors every sibling cross-story gateway. ScanAsync reduces a mapping's full applied-batch history to the most-recent snapshot per external key, then raises/augments/withdraws/reopens an ImportConflictReview record (natural key TenantId/MappingId/ExternalKey, mirrors BIO-IDN-005's own DuplicateCandidate CAS shape) - never touches a row with a terminal human decision (same 'never re-detects a decided pair' discipline as DuplicateReviewService). AC02: DecideAsync requires permission integrations.conflict_review_decide (IPermissionGateway wrapping BIO-IDN-006's real PermissionService) plus a verified ActorProvenanceGate proof, mirroring BIO-INT-002's own ApplyAsync; exactly three decisions - KEEP_EXISTING/USE_SOURCE/ESCALATED. AC03: every raise/augment/withdraw/reopen/decide writes an append-only audit event before committing (ADR-0003 Decision 7 pattern - per-row lock, audit-before-commit, ExistsAsync-on-throw verification, CancellationToken.None post-confirm), detail never carries a compared field value. AC04: structurally enforced, not merely documented - no ProjectReference to BIO-IDN-001 or BIO-INT-002 exists at all, so nothing here CAN write to PERSON; USE_SOURCE records the human's choice but never applies it, since BIO-INT-002's own ImportBatchService header already disclosed PERSON has no field-mutator (RegisterAsync/UpdateStatusAsync only) - this is the second story to hit that exact disclosed gap, documented again in docs/features/bio-int-005/README.md. AC05: new web/features/bio-int-005 (ports/mock/live/index, resolvePort pattern) plus ConflictReviewPanel.tsx mounted on /administration/integrations alongside ImportConsole/ServiceAccountsPanel/WebhookSubscriptionsPanel (never replacing any). Reused BIO-INT-002's own 'Integrations:ActorProvenanceSecret' configuration key and route nesting (/api/v1/integrations/mappings/{mappingId}/conflicts/*) so the already-registered web/lib/actor-provenance-routes.ts prefix entry covers this story's own decide endpoint with no route-table change needed. /settings/authentication deliberately out of scope, same disclosed boundary every sibling IntegrationService story states. AC05 bar matched to this specific conflict group's own established precedent (BIO-INT-004, same page, SIMULATION-mode Playwright proof in the default suite) rather than the heavier live-demo-bridge proof BIO-TEN-003/BIO-ATT-003 needed for a different UI area - confirmed by reading docs/features/bio-int-004/README.md before designing, not assumed by analogy.

Self-caught regression while writing the Playwright proof: ConflictReviewPanel's handleList() (called by handleDecide to refresh after a successful decision) unconditionally cleared the `notice` state at its own start, wiping out the decision's own just-set success message before the assertion could see it - two tests failed with 'notice: element not found' despite the decision genuinely succeeding (confirmed via the row's own status cell already showing the new state in the Playwright error-context snapshot). Fixed by having handleList leave notice alone; only handleScan (an explicit fresh load) clears it for itself. Caught by own test suite, not a reviewer.

Pre-existing gap closed while touching this module, not introduced here: web/lib/module-registry.ts's IntegrationService entry had never registered BIO-INT-003's four port keys or BIO-INT-004's three (only primaryAction was present) - confirmed via running tests/frontend/unit/bio-ux-005-module-registry.test.ts and bio-ux-005-feature-mode.test.ts before touching anything, both already failing. Fixed for all ten non-primaryAction keys at once (seven pre-existing plus this story's own three) while already editing this file, same 'fix the whole class in one pass' discipline this codebase applies elsewhere; added the explicit IntegrationService entry to bio-ux-005-feature-mode.test.ts's own hardcoded multi-port-module assertion too.

Verification process note: an early combined Playwright regression run (shell/axe/webhooks/own spec) showed 17 failures across routes this story never touches (reports/audit/administration/students/card-designer/etc) - root-caused via the production server's own log rather than assumed to be a real regression: a concurrent `npx next build` had rebuilt .next's output directory out from under the already-running `next start` server, crashing it mid-run (confirmed via `lsof`/curl showing the server had died). Restarted the server on a fresh port with no further build calls, re-ran the full set: 120/122 passed, exactly 2 failures, both isolated to /audit (BIO-RPT-001/003 territory, axe accessibility, pre-existing and unrelated to anything this story touches).

Full verification: dotnet build clean (0 warnings/0 errors). Own suite 20/20. Full Biolog.IntegrationTests 253/253 (244 prior + 9 new, zero regression). Module-reference/contract-freeze/traceability/secret-scan all PASS. Web: npx tsc --noEmit clean, npx next build clean (/administration/integrations prerenders). Frontend unit 548/548 (was 547/548 with 1 known gap before this story's own module-registry fix - now fully clean, confirmed by diffing actual assertion content per BIO-ATT-003's own established lesson, not just file/count matching). Playwright: bio-int-005-conflict-review.spec.ts 6/6, bio-int-004-webhooks.spec.ts/bio-ux-002-shell.spec.ts/bio-ux-013-axe-baseline.spec.ts 114/116 (2 pre-existing /audit failures, confirmed unrelated by route ownership).
